component.name: OPL Backup Manager
component.summary: Prepare PS2/PS1 backups for OPL on USB/MX4SIO

description.p: Cross-platform desktop app that prepares a PS2/PS1 library for Open PS2 Loader (OPL/RiptOPL) on a USB or MX4SIO drive. Ingests raw PS2 .iso and PS1 .cue/.bin, classifies CD vs DVD, converts PS1 to VCD with DISCS.TXT/VMCDIR.TXT, splits >4 GiB to USBExtreme for FAT32, and copies one file at a time to avoid fragmentation.
Never modifies sources, validates DISCS.TXT/VMCDIR.TXT/ul.cfg before enqueue, and persists queue in SQLite for resume.
Initial release: M1-M5 (loader, art, cheats, Ember, pre-flight) with Wails desktop and headless CLI.
